## Exercise 1: Using functions
```{r}
# whole number
round(3.14159)

# two digits after decimal point
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```

## Exercise 2: Argument order
```{r}
# specified by order
print(rep(5, 7))

# using keywords
print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```
